query: Status update sintetico dell'installazione in produzione, target gio 19.11. Numeri di oggi 13.11: A 17/17, B 4/5 bloccato da un ticket di permessi senza data, C 1/41, D senza numeri
expected_behavior: States the target path and waits for confirmation before writing the page
Shows each activity with installed over total and its percentage, plus a Totale overall row computed only over the activities that have numbers (22/63, 35%)
Never colours B green: an open blocker without a resolution date makes it yellow, with the reason next to the light
Shows D grey with no percentage and no light colour, and keeps it out of the total
Does not invent an ETA for C from a single data point: ETA is shown as not computable and the light is yellow, not red

query: Pre-UAT Germania, target ven 20.11. Il 05.11 la linea X era a 6 su 16, oggi lunedi' 16.11 e' a 8 su 16. Fammi lo status update executive
expected_behavior: Computes the pace from the two snapshots in working days (2 tests over 7 working days) and an ETA from it, skipping Saturdays and Sundays
Colours line X red because the ETA from the pace falls more than the recovery margin after the target, and writes that reason in one line
Shows the date of the data on the section and does not compare against the earlier snapshot anywhere else on the page

query: Aggiungi alla pagina un blocker: il change del 25.11 serve per sbloccare l'attivita' Y, target 20.11
expected_behavior: Lists the blocker under the chart of its section with activity, owner, ticket or 'ticket da fornire', and the expected resolution date
Turns activity Y red, because the stated resolution date falls after the target, whatever its percentage
Recomputes the overall light of the section as the worst light among its activities
